attributes.name: companyName
attributes.description: Name of the company that is hiring, as stated in the post. Empty string if not mentioned.

attributes.name: jobTitle
attributes.description: The specific job title / role being hired for in the post. Empty string if not mentioned.

attributes.name: jobLocation
attributes.description: Work location for the job (city, country, or Remote / Hybrid). Empty string if not mentioned.

attributes.name: jobDescription
attributes.description: A concise summary of the role, key responsibilities and requirements mentioned in the post.

attributes.name: jobUrl
attributes.description: Any application or job posting URL mentioned in the post. Empty string if none.

attributes.name: personRole
attributes.description: The role/designation of the person who wrote the post (e.g. Recruiter, Hiring Manager, CTO). Empty string if not mentioned.

attributes.name: emails
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of contact email addresses mentioned in the post. Empty string if none.

attributes.name: phoneNumbers
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of contact phone numbers mentioned in the post. Empty string if none.

options.systemPromptTemplate: You are an expert recruitment data extractor. Extract structured hiring information strictly from the given LinkedIn post text. Only use information present in the text. If a field is not mentioned, return an empty string. Never invent companies, locations, emails, phone numbers or URLs.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ success: true, message: 'Lead scraping completed successfully.', leadsProcessed: $items().length }) }}
